name: Eris the Dark Enchantress
source:
Eris the Dark Enchantress is a formidable mutant, endowed with the power to hypnotize her enemies in terrible and unexpected ways. With her dark magic, she can make them believe they are immobilized by a spell, wrapped in flames, or trapped in fiery prisons. Her illusions are so powerful that only the sharpest minds have managed to break her hypnotic yoke after superhuman efforts. Skilled in manipulating the mind, Eris is a master of the deepest fears, capable of driving anyone to madness with the mere power of her will.
